given: a profile whose ui_config.json sets ditaAttributes.required.navtitle to true
when: an author inserts an existing DITA topic as a reference in the Map Editor and saves
then: the saved <topicref> in Source mode carries a @navtitle attribute
evidence: Jira GUIDES-54348 expected result; documented behaviour Include @navtitle attribute by default
raw: AC-01 [Proposed]: (Basic) Given a profile whose ui_config.json sets ditaAttributes.required.navtitle to true | When an author inserts an existing DITA topic as a reference in the Map Editor and saves | Then the saved <topicref> in Source mode carries a @navtitle attribute | Evidence: Jira GUIDES-54348 expected result; documented behaviour Include @navtitle attribute by default.

given: navtitle is required and a topic with a known <title> is referenced
when: the topicref is inserted
then: the @navtitle value equals the referenced topic's <title> text exactly
evidence: Jira GUIDES-54348 example navtitle="Topic 1"; xmleditor insert_topicref_controller updateNavTitle derives navtitle from the fetched title
